meaning: Inventory of reported positive event starts only; not a model evaluation.

sources.official_source: Sistema Nacional de Manejo del Fuego daily occurrence reports

report_coverage.interpretation: No report is an unknown observation. A PDF with zero extracted rows may reflect report content or parser failure and was not called an official fire-free day.

regions: Cerro Ventana - Hueco de la Ventana
Bosque Tallado desde la plataforma del Piltriquitron
spatial_protocol.distance_measure: Haversine between incident coordinates and fixed route-sector center
spatial_protocol.unit: route-sector start day; multiple incident records on the same route/date are grouped

limitations: Daily SNMF reports are jurisdiction-reported and not an exhaustive national event/no-event registry.
2 of 274 dates have no PDF at the checked paths; these are unknown, never negative.
The automated extraction has 289 report snapshot rows without coordinates and 1 reports with zero parsed event rows; original PDFs require review for those cases.
Event starts may be approximate and duplicate naming may remain; route-day aggregation avoids treating duplicate records at the same route/date as separate positives.
Route-sector centers do not represent the complete trail geometry.
